items.title: Expedia’s $676 Million in Acquisitions Points to More B2B Buying
items.summary: Expedia’s 2026 deals are a fraction of the nearly $6 billion it spent in 2015. But three acquisitions in nine months, plus CEO Ariane Gorin’s pledge to keep investing, signal that Expedia is a buyer again. And B2B is where the money is going.

items.title: Hard Rock Hotels Plug Into Accor Without Selling a Stake
items.summary: Hard Rock keeps its equity and hands Accor the task of developing its pipeline of non-casino hotels. Accor collects ongoing fees and gets a well-known brand to essentially rent out to its loyalty members.

items.title: Expedia Goes Live on Muse, but Its AI Wins Are Inside Its Own Apps
items.summary: Expedia's Muse connection is live: CEO Ariane Gorin noted it may even have happened during the OTA's earnings call this week. So Skift took it for a spin to see what it can and cannot do.

items.title: AI Agents Still Need Middlemen. But Will They Need Amadeus?
items.summary: Amadeus has the scale and airline relationships, but those advantages don't guarantee it a direct role in AI-agent bookings.

items.title: Aviation’s Next Disaster Could Be In Your Carry-On
items.summary: Battery incidents are rising and airlines are tightening restrictions, with cabin crews the last line of defense. Is the industry doing enough to prevent the next fire, or simply getting better at putting them out?

items.title: Airbnb Sells IP to AI Lab Owned by Its CEO and CTO
items.summary: Airbnb’s CEO and CTO both own part of the lab buying its IP, but the filing gives shareholders little detail on what changed hands.
